category_edits.rationale: Anchor positions to recency across all four category models: the newest nonpadding token receives position 1 and padding remains 0. Apply identically to masked training and appended-mask inference through the shared model class imported by the generated predictor. Preserve history selection, final-mask readout, parameter shapes, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer.

change_summary: Replace chronological position IDs with reverse nonpadding ranks. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so training and inference remain consistent without writer changes.
